Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two distinct affinity-based methods: TurboID (proximity labeling) and co-IP (AP-MS). Acquisition mode (DDA vs DIA) is not explicitly stated, but the use of Proteome Discoverer and the nature of AP-MS typically align with DDA. No PTMs were reported in the PRIDE metadata.

scope: the supernatant was incubated with streptavidin beads, which was blocked with 1% bovine serum albumin, at 4°C. Beads were then washed with RIPA lysis buffer containing 2 M urea, and MYCN and associated proteins were then eluted with 8 M urea.
the supernatant was incubated with Flag beads, and then MYCN and associated proteins were harvested by Tobacco Etch Virus protease digestion to remove the flag tag.
Purified proteins were digested with typsin (Promega, #V5280) and desalted with C18 columns (Thermo Fisher Scientific, #87782).
